title: Coral and the Promise
author: Felix Dravenmoor
blurb: Rafael Blackwood, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
